topic: What the outbound terms check does not see
detail: Accepted for now and documented (docs/internals/hooks.md, Outbound terms): text sent by a script or program that runs git itself (./deploy.sh, make), an interpreter, curl to the GitHub API, or a tool other than a shell (notably GitHub MCP tools), and commits a push would send that a session hid by moving local remote-tracking refs. gh search and gh api GET queries send terms to GitHub without publishing them. Proposed: cover GitHub MCP tools' write calls the same way, and compare with git ls-remote before a push when a remote's tracking ref moved in the same session.
note: 2026-11-14: settled by D-60 (best-effort, loosened baseline in SP-044; configurable rules in SP-075).
